verdict.rationale: LightSprint's marketing says users can bring their own API keys or Codex/Claude subscriptions, 'pick any model through OpenRouter', and route model traffic through an approved gateway. That supports choosing a specific model. Nothing in the evidence shows an automatic model-selection default, or a control for switching from it to a pinned model. Missing for 10: evidence of an automatic/default model-selection mode and a documented override toggle, per-task or per-agent model selection in the UI, in-depth docs beyond homepage one-liners, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
